question: Do the Antamina PMPA thresholds belong to one stream or two?
entity_or_metric: BHP versus Glencore Antamina silver PMPAs
evidence_value: BHP PMPA: 33.75% until 100 Moz then 22.5% LOM; legacy Glencore PMPA: 33.75% until 140 Moz then 22.5% LOM; Investor Day pages 37, 41, and 47 separately identify the BHP/Glencore routes and show the combined Antamina reserve denominator
what_is_proven: Presentation page references corroborate separate BHP and Glencore threshold denominators and prevent combined Antamina rows from being assigned to BHP alone
